steps.title: Provider intake & readiness
steps.description: Collect the provider's data and documents and run an internal pre-check before contacting the payer, so the application isn't rejected for basics.
tasks: Collect intake packet (demographics, licenses, education, work history)
Confirm NPI Type 1 active & correct in NPPES
Verify license, DEA and board status are current
Run OIG LEIE & SAM.gov exclusion check
Confirm malpractice COI meets payer limits
steps.tip: Fix expirables now - an item that expires mid-review restarts verification at most plans.

steps.title: Request participation (portal or phone)
steps.description: Confirm the network is open for this specialty and location, then start the credentialing request on the payer portal or by calling provider relations.
tasks: Confirm panel is open for specialty / county
Check if group already has a contract (add-on vs new contract)
steps.tip: If the group is already contracted, ask for a 'provider add' - it is usually much faster than a new contract.

steps.title: CAQH ProView & documents
steps.description: Most commercial plans pull the application from CAQH ProView. Update the profile, upload current documents, re-attest, and authorize this payer.
tasks: Import / review provider data from CAQH
Authorize this payer to view the profile
steps.tip: An expired attestation is the #1 cause of 'application not received'. Re-attest the same day you submit.

steps.title: Submit application
steps.description: Submit the application (portal upload or CAQH pull) with the group roster, W-9 and practice locations.
tasks: Group roster with TIN / group NPI / locations

steps.title: Acknowledgment & completeness
steps.description: Confirm the payer received the file and marked it complete. Missing items stop the clock, so resolve them quickly.
steps.tip: Call if there's no acknowledgment in 7-10 business days.

steps.title: In progress - verification & committee
steps.description: The payer performs primary-source verification (NCQA requires it within 120 days of the provider's attestation) and presents the file to its credentialing committee.
steps.tip: Follow up every 14 days and log the rep's name and call reference each time.

steps.title: Contracting
steps.description: Credentialing approval and contracting are separate. Review the agreement and fee schedule, sign, and get the fully executed copy.

steps.title: Approved & loaded
steps.description: Record the effective date and provider ID, then load into billing and confirm the first claims pay in-network.
steps.tip: Don't schedule in-network patients before the effective date - most commercial plans don't pay retroactively.

steps.title: Maintain & recredential
steps.description: Keep the provider in network: CAQH re-attestation every 120 days, expirables tracking, monthly exclusion checks, and recredentialing every 36 months.

steps.title: Pre-enrollment readiness
steps.description: Make sure NPPES, licensing and access are in place before starting PECOS - NPPES data must match the application exactly.
tasks: NPI active; NPPES address & taxonomy correct
State license active in the practice state
steps.tip: Name, NPI and practice address must match NPPES and the license, or the MAC will send a development letter.

steps.title: Create credential (I&A + PECOS)
steps.description: Create or confirm the provider's Identity & Access (I&A) account, connect the group's authorized official / surrogate, and open the PECOS application. Call the MAC enrollment line if you can't file online.
steps.tip: PECOS web filing is processed faster than paper and gives you live status.

steps.title: Gather data & documents
steps.description: CMS doesn't use CAQH, but pulling the CAQH profile is the fastest way to pre-fill PECOS. Upload supporting documents.

steps.title: Sign & submit
steps.description: Provider and the group's authorized official e-sign in PECOS. The filing date determines the effective date.
steps.tip: Effective date = later of the filing date or the date services began. You can bill up to 30 days before the effective date. File before the provider starts seeing patients.

steps.title: MAC acknowledgment
steps.description: Confirm the MAC received the application and assigned a web tracking ID.

steps.title: In progress - review & development
steps.description: The MAC reviews the application. Development (missing information) requests stop the clock and must be answered within 30 days, or the application is rejected.
steps.tip: Clean web applications usually finish within a few weeks; development or site visits can push it toward ~85 days.

steps.title: Approved - PTAN issued
steps.description: The MAC sends the approval letter with the PTAN and effective date. Set up claims, EFT/ERA and the MAC portal.
tasks: Loaded into billing; first claim paid
steps.tip: Medicare Advantage plans credential separately - start those under the commercial workflow.

steps.title: Maintain & revalidate
steps.description: Revalidate when CMS requests (generally every 5 years) and report enrollment changes on time.
tasks: Report ownership / adverse actions / location changes within 30 days

steps.title: Pre-enrollment readiness
steps.description: Confirm the state's requirements and the provider's screening risk level (limited, moderate or high). Most physicians are limited risk.
tasks: Medicare enrollment status confirmed (many states expect it)
OIG / SAM / state exclusion check clear

steps.title: Create credential (state portal)
steps.description: Create the provider account on the state Medicaid enrollment portal (for example TMHP in Texas), or call the state provider enrollment line.

steps.title: Gather data & documents
steps.description: Pull data from CAQH to complete the state application, and prepare the disclosure of ownership and the provider agreement.

steps.title: Submit application
steps.description: Submit the state application. An application fee applies to institutional providers; individual practitioners are usually exempt.

steps.title: Acknowledgment & completeness
steps.description: Confirm the state accepted the application as complete and resolve any deficiency notices.

steps.title: In progress - state screening
steps.description: The state checks federal and state databases. Moderate and high risk providers get a site visit; high risk providers also need fingerprint-based background checks.
tasks: Database screening (NPPES, LEIE, SAM, state lists)

steps.title: Approved - Medicaid ID issued
steps.description: Record the Medicaid ID and effective date, and load it into billing.

steps.title: Medicaid MCO credentialing
steps.description: Most Medicaid members are in managed care plans, and each MCO credentials separately (usually through CAQH) after state enrollment.
tasks: List MCOs in the service area
steps.tip: Track each MCO as its own commercial-style workflow if you need per-plan detail.

steps.title: Maintain & revalidate
steps.description: States revalidate at least every 5 years. Keep CAQH current for the MCOs, and report changes to the state.

emailTemplates.name: Request participation / application
emailTemplates.subject: Participation request - {{providerName}}, {{credentials}} (NPI {{npi}})

emailTemplates.name: CAQH profile ready
emailTemplates.subject: CAQH profile ready - {{providerName}} (CAQH {{caqhId}})

emailTemplates.name: Confirm receipt & completeness
emailTemplates.subject: Confirmation of receipt - {{providerName}} (NPI {{npi}})
emailTemplates.body:
Hello,

We submitted the application for {{providerName}} (NPI {{npi}}) on {{submittedDate}}.

Could you please confirm it was received and is complete, and share the reference number?

Thank you,
{{senderName}}

emailTemplates.name: Status follow-up
emailTemplates.subject: Status follow-up - {{providerName}}, Ref {{referenceNo}}

emailTemplates.name: Response to missing-information request
emailTemplates.subject: Requested information - {{providerName}}, Ref {{referenceNo}}
emailTemplates.body:
Hello,

Attached is the information requested for {{providerName}} (NPI {{npi}}), reference #{{referenceNo}}:

- [list items]

Please confirm receipt and let us know if anything else is needed.

Thank you,
{{senderName}}

emailTemplates.name: Contract / fee schedule follow-up
emailTemplates.subject: Agreement status - {{providerName}} / {{practice}}
emailTemplates.body:
Hello,

Credentialing for {{providerName}} (NPI {{npi}}) is complete. Could you please send the participation agreement and fee schedule, or confirm the provider has been added to our existing group agreement (TIN {{tin}})?

Thank you,
{{senderName}}

emailTemplates.name: Request effective date & provider ID
emailTemplates.subject: Effective date & provider ID - {{providerName}}
emailTemplates.body:
Hello,

Thank you for approving {{providerName}} (NPI {{npi}}). Please confirm the effective date and assigned provider ID, and send the fully executed agreement and welcome letter.

Thank you,
{{senderName}}

emailTemplates.name: Recredentialing / revalidation
emailTemplates.subject: Recredentialing - {{providerName}} (NPI {{npi}})
emailTemplates.body:
Hello,

{{providerName}} (NPI {{npi}}, provider ID {{payerProviderId}}) is approaching the recredentialing / revalidation date. The CAQH profile (ID {{caqhId}}) is current and attested. Please let us know if any forms are needed.

Thank you,
{{senderName}}
